coder_notes: Early Phase 1 surgical window-of-opportunity trial. Both groups are registered EXPERIMENTAL and both receive troriluzole; Group B gets it only after surgery, so it acts as the no-presurgical-drug comparison (control_arm_from_other_arms coded yes). Pharmacodynamic biomarkers are not eligibility/enrichment, so they do not affect the primary outcome.
